titulo: Brendan Carr says he’ll let Pete Hegseth decide whether TV networks can air the public execution
cuerpo: FCC chairman Brendan Carr said he will defer to Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on whether TV networks can air the planned execution of convicted Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan by firing squad.
